The .do recodes 3 (the unprompted, not-read-aloud midpoint), 8 and 9 to missing, so the live resp set is {1,2,4,5} and option rows ship for exactly those four codes; no row for 3. CHECKED ANYWAY, decisive: reading DA3212 (2468 records, all 395 bytes; id = row number) at cols 193-198, dropping 3/8/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 210 and cov_age cols 211-213 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 12799 rows both, 2376 live ids, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp and 0 cov_age mismatches; cov_sex is stored in the live table as the Stata value label (1 -> 'Hombre' 6323 rows, 2 -> 'Mujer' 6476 rows, no cross cells). Live item x resp (1/2/4/5): P27_1 705/1262/119/34, P27_2 695/1366/99/27, P27_3 867/1270/48/12, P27_4 618/1243/184/30, P27_5 670/1341/111/19, P27_6 675/1172/188/44 -- every item uses all four levels. Dropped by the .do (codes 3/8/9): P27_1 170/176/2, P27_2 162/117/2, P27_3 132/138/1, P27_4 191/201/1, P27_5 145/179/3, P27_6 240/141/8. Live values read from the local irw cache copy table_context.R had just written (~/.cache/irw), no extra export; validate_items.R --table-sets passed (6 items, resp {1,2,4,5}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the P.27 stem verbatim from cues3212.pdf (pdftotext -raw), shared by all six grid rows, so instructions not section_prompt, one trivial section. Its opening 'Más concretamente' refers back to P.26 (whether the administrations should adopt measures to encourage renting); P.26 is not in this table and is not reproduced. No filter is printed for P.26/P.27 (asked of everyone) and no show card exists for P.27 in tarjetas3212.pdf. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3212 in Spanish only; the _translated columns are English written by this project (issues-page line owed at upload). RIGHTS: instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, irw#2381, every CIS survey year) applied, not re-derived.
public_note: Code 3 on this five-point scale was an unprompted 'neither in favour nor against' answer (not read aloud to respondents) and is stored as missing, together with don't-know and no-answer, so resp takes the values 1, 2, 4 and 5 only; item text English is IRW machine translation of the Spanish-only CIS questionnaire
